text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
ADEVARUL
- A senior Finance Ministry official said on Wednesday year-on-year inflation in Romania in December will be 35 to 38 percent.
- Support for capital markets, stepped-up privatisation and restructuring are among the targets the incoming government should meet, Economic Reform Minister Mircea Cosea said.
- Romanian farmers are faced with diesel oil shortages despite assurances of fuel supply from the National Oil Company.
TINERETUL LIBER
- A recently created 44 million Ecus post-privatisation fund will secure equity financing for private companies.
- Enterprise Oil recently said it was interested in expanding crude exploration work in the Black Sea continental shelf.
ZIUA
- The leu currency's rate at retail currency shops nears 4,500 to the dollar.
General:
ROMANIA LIBERA
- Editorial urges voters to cast their ballot for opposition leader Emil Constantinescu in run-off for president on November 17.
- Former European Parliament MP Francois Froment-Meurice says in interview President Ion Iliescu allegedly holds his position "through force and fraud".
ADEVARUL
- The opposition Democratic Convention (CDR) and Social Democratic Union (USD) sign cooperation accord for presidential run-off, parliament and government.

- The victory of the opposition in the November 3 parliamentary poll and a possible victory of Constantinescu in run-offs should be consolidated by the creation of a centre-right government, analyst Silviu Brucan says.
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI
- Allegations over a split within the Orthodox church are a serious threat to national security, says editorial on letter allegedly signed by several priests to sack Orthodox Patriarch Teoctist.
- The PDSR plans to create parliamentary commission to protect PDSR ex-digniataries expected to be sacked by the opposition.
LIBERTATEA
- The newspaper publishes electoral map of Romania showing the way population voted for various politicians in the country's 41 counties and Bucharest.
DIMINEATA

- The newspaper publishes president Iliescu's statement on Wednesday saying he had proved so far to be "the man of reconciliation and good understanding". ($=3,430 lei) -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
